title: Canonical uniform circuit family
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits with logspace-decidable adjacency information, and suppose that for every input length $n$ the output vertex of $C_n$ satisfies $\mathrm{output}(C_n)+1=\mathrm{size}(C_n)$. Then there is a canonical circuit family $C'$ such that $C'_n$ and $C_n$ compute the same Boolean function for every $n$, and $C'$ is logspace-uniform.
hypotheses_covered: For every gate type, $C$'s type language is in LOGSPACE
